character: The Merian hut is a Pokemon Center, a woodshed and a stable in a high cirque: its Pokemon chop the wood and mind the stable, two birds live on it, and two Mankey have stolen the washing. Mountain species only.
authored_by: town author A, 2026-10-05, by hand; positions measured from derived/towns/merian_hut_plan.json, merian_hut_placement.json and tools/ground.py (rounded) through tools/ambient.py's Site; the yard is not cut (plaza y 107, ground 107); y is the standing y

workers.interact: The Skiddo minds the stable door and eats its hay one mouthful at a time, very slowly, so there is always some left.
The Kleavor splits the woodshed's logs with one stroke each. The hut has not bought an axe in years.

placed.why: a Spearow on the stable roof, shouting at the wind
a Bunnelby on the woodshed step, ears out, digging a hole nobody asked for

situations.title: Who took the washing
situations.story: Two Mankey stole the hut's washing off the line and have hung it on the stable fence, and one of them is wearing a sock.
situations.why: the yard between the stable and the Pokemon Center
